summary: Tests-only red phase for issue #5. Wrote stubbed-response tests for the generated OpenAPI client (all six /api/v1 surfaces) and the app facade's ranked-results surface, plus a LID doc recording the contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (viamin/color_matching#113) and the endpoint gaps found. Tests cannot execute in this container: no Swift toolchain is installed, and the ColorMatchingAPIClient target does not exist until the implementation run adds swift-openapi-generator plus the vendored openapi.json. Lint/test commands are not configured for this repo (verified no-ops).

acceptance_criteria.description: Add swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime to the iOS package; vendor the OpenAPI document from viamin/color_matching#110

verification.reason: Implementation change (Package.swift + Sources) is out of scope for the tests-only run; upstream dependency viamin/color_matching#110 was verified complete (PR #113 merged 2026-10-30) with the vendoring command documented.

acceptance_criteria.description: Generate the client for the surfaces the app uses: manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results

verification.reason: Red-phase tests pin all six surfaces (paths, methods, operation IDs, wire JSON, documented decode fields) but cannot compile until the implementation run adds the generated client target; no Swift toolchain exists in this container to run them.

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace hand-written API models with generated types; keep purely client-side models

verification.reason: Facade tests pin generated-type exposure (Components.Schemas.RankedResults return type) and existing APIClientTests continue to pin facade wire behavior; migration itself is the implementation run's change.

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift tests exercising the generated client against local stubbed responses (no live server in CI)

verification.reason: Tests are written entirely against local stubs (stub ClientTransport + URLProtocol) with no live server, but cannot be executed: `swift` is not installed in this container and the referenced ColorMatchingAPIClient module does not exist yet (red phase).

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records contract deltas between the prose contract and the published spec, and endpoint gaps discovered

verification.reason: Eleven documented deltas/gaps (including anyOf-sibling hollowing of CaptureRequest/PairScoreRequest, manifest/ranked-results under-documentation, 200-with-body vs 204 uploads) are recorded in the LID doc as the seed for the final PR description; the PR itself is published by Paid after test approval, so PR-description evidence does not exist yet.
